name: automatic-pr-lifecycle
description: Coordinate a protected, evidence-backed pull request lifecycle with GitHub MCP and a scoped CLI fallback.

interface.shortDescription: Shepherd protected pull requests through verified merge or an evidenced blocker.
interface.longDescription: A GitHub MCP-first pull request lifecycle skill for local validation, PR creation, CI and review repair, exact-head readiness, explicit landing confirmation, merge observation, and final reporting. It uses gh or gh api only as a scoped fallback and never bypasses hooks, required checks, reviews, merge queues, or branch protection.
capabilities: MCP-based CI and review state reconciliation
GitHub MCP-first operations with gh fallback
Protected merge observation and evidence reporting
defaultPrompt: Use $automatic-pr-lifecycle to take this pull request through the protected lifecycle and report its verified terminal state.
